title: StrictlyVC in conversation with Sam Altman, part two (OpenAI)
summary: Part two of a StrictlyVC interview with OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, focused on AI. He discusses regulation, commodification of AI, Google's reluctance to release its own models, and best- and worst-case futures.
why: HN commenters cite it as a primary source for Altman's statements, such as releasing AI more slowly, detection of LLM output being futile, and dismissing the GPT-4 parameter-count rumor.
